combat_progression.rationale: Full credit for demonstrated combat depth: multiple enemy types, hit points, enemy fire, collisions, scoring, lives, invulnerability, wave scaling, particles, and game-over state are implemented and visibly exercised.
evidence: app.js:20-34 implements drones/tanks, projectile collisions, 100/250-point scoring, damage/lives, enemy shots, wave-based speed/spawn scaling, and game-over.
desktop-after.png visibly shows final score 007317, SIGNAL LOST/MISSION TERMINATED, and multiple enemy silhouettes.
automated.json records playing state with 5 enemies and over state with score 7317.

visual_design.rationale: Full credit: the retained desktop and mobile captures show a cohesive, polished neon/orbital art direction with strong hierarchy, responsive layout, game-over feedback, glowing controls, and touch UI.
evidence: desktop-before.png shows consistent cyan/pink/yellow palette, scanline treatment, panel hierarchy, typography, HUD, and launch overlay.
desktop-after.png shows colored enemy visuals, glow effects, final-score feedback, transmission status, and relaunch affordance.
mobile.png shows a responsive single-column layout with readable overlays, visible touch controls, and leaderboard below the game.
styles.css:1-4 and app.js:36-46 implement scanlines, gradients, grid/stars, glows, particles, shake, animation, and responsive breakpoints.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The remaining handling points are supported by explicit loading, empty, missing-configuration, validation, and network-error states plus semantic labels/status messaging; the captures show the unavailable-score fallback without making the game UI unusable.
evidence: app.js:51-53 handles missing Supabase configuration, empty results, failed fetches, invalid names, and retryable submission errors.
index.html:15,25,35,39-48 includes labels, aria-labels, aria-describedby, and role=status elements.
desktop-before.png and desktop-after.png visibly show Scores temporarily unavailable and Transmission failed. Try again.
automated.json confirms 7 labeled elements, while also recording the separate invalid pattern and 401 console errors.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in migration provides strong static security evidence, but the retained remote check returned 401 for both intended anon GET and POST requests, so deployed policy behavior and a working authorized round trip are not demonstrated.
evidence: supabase/migrations/001_scores.sql:1-22 creates server-side name/score checks, enables RLS, restricts policies to anon, revokes public table access, and grants only select/insert plus sequence access.
config.js:1 and app.js:51-53 use the public anon credential for REST calls; no service-role or management credential is present in the browser source.
test.log records the migration/RLS validation test passing.
automated.json records Supabase GET and POST status 401 and all leaderboard persistence/submission checks failing; the benchmark-result.json claim of round_trip=true is therefore not used.

engineering_quality.rationale: Build and tests pass, the dependency-free structure has a lockfile, and tests cover validation, required UI/test surface, and migration properties. Credit is reduced for compressed/minified source, shallow static tests, a build that only runs node --check, and the observed browser integration defects.
evidence: build.exit-code and build.log show npm run build exiting 0 via node --check app.js.
test.exit-code and test.log show 3 passing Node tests covering input/score contracts, required selectors/adapter, and migration security.
package.json and package-lock.json provide reproducible scripts and a lockfile for the dependency-free project.
automated.json records the invalid HTML pattern regex and 401 resource errors, with leaderboard and browser-error checks failing.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is substantially reproducible: source, migration, README, scripts, tests, and lockfile are present. One point is withheld because deployment/verification is documented only as generic commands, without a checked-in deployment configuration or explicit end-to-end verification procedure.
evidence: README.md:5-33 documents local setup, controls, architecture, deployment, credential boundaries, and the production test adapter.
supabase/migrations/001_scores.sql is a checked-in schema/policy reproduction artifact.
package.json, package-lock.json, and test/app.test.js provide the local command and test handoff.
source-manifest.txt lists the retained source, README, migration, lockfile, tests, and result artifacts.

summary: Manual total: 40/46. Visual and combat evidence is strong; the main deductions are the unverified/broken Supabase round trip, browser integration errors, and limited engineering/deployment automation.
